neighbours.label: the spelling piece ' cock' or ' Cock' at the start of a longer word (cockatoo, cockup, Cockburn, cockerel, cockroach)
fire: A sulphur-crested cockatoo screamed from the top of the gum tree.

notes: Card: ' cock' x5, ' Cock' x3, 'ck', all in non-sexual uses (Cockburn, cockups, cockatoo), plus outliers ('한', '这种', ' the') at the top. Probes: cockups 0.725, cockatoo 0.638, cockerel 0.588, Cockburn 0.580; Fowler 0.041. Whole-token ' cockpit' and ' cocktail' are avoided since they do not contain the piece. Fire sentences use only bird, insect, surname and error senses.
